title: REPORT on the financial activities of the European Investment Bank – annual report 2024
part_text: 9. Recalls, however, that the EIB’s operations are by nature limited and can only play a supporting role in addressing the significant investment gap; warns against the illusion that ever closer European integration (capital markets union, banking union, etc.) alone will resolve this deficit; believes that these projects must not under any circumstances lead to the mutualisation of European debt or the centralisation of financial decision-making to the detriment of Member States;
